note: From the lowob event rankings. Dates as published by organisers; confirm before booking.

items.name: Consensus Miami
items.best_for: US institutions, exchanges, founders and investors in one place
items.watch: Expensive; side events book out early

items.name: Devcon 8
items.best_for: Ethereum builders, wallets, infrastructure teams
items.watch: Builder crowd, less buying power; long trip from the US

items.name: EthCC[10]
items.best_for: European Ethereum and DeFi teams
items.watch: Earlier editions ran in summer, so confirm the April dates on the official site

items.name: TOKEN2049 Dubai
items.best_for: Exchanges, MENA capital, offshore venue BD teams
items.watch: Postponed from 2026 over regional security; check travel advice nearer the time

items.name: Solana Breakpoint
items.best_for: Solana payments and consumer apps
items.watch: First UK edition; ecosystem-specific

items.name: Consensus Hong Kong
items.where: Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre
items.best_for: Asian exchanges and institutions
items.watch: Asia-heavy crowd; expo floor only on the last two days

items.name: ETHDenver 2027
items.dates: Not yet announced (2026 ran 17 to 21 Feb)
items.best_for: Hackers, grants teams, early-stage founders
items.watch: Dates not yet announced; check the organiser's site.

items.name: Bitcoin 2027
items.best_for: Bitcoin-native companies, miners, treasury companies
items.watch: Moved from Las Vegas; very Bitcoin-only

items.name: DeFi Security Summit
items.best_for: Protocol risk and security teams
items.watch: Niche, and only days away

items.name: Bluechip26
items.best_for: Stablecoin risk and ratings
items.watch: Niche: security, stablecoin risk and regulation

items.name: Gartner Data & Analytics Summit
items.best_for: Chief data and analytics officers comparing governance and operating models

items.name: Money20/20 Europe

items.name: AWS re:Invent
items.best_for: Agent infrastructure on AWS, which many data and ratings firms run on

items.name: Microsoft Ignite
items.best_for: Copilot, agent identity and governance for Microsoft 365 shops
items.watch: Prices not published on the site

items.name: HumanX
items.best_for: Chief AI officers and AI security leaders across industries
items.watch: $2,995 early, rising to $3,995; free "Adopter" passes by application

items.name: Google Cloud Next
items.best_for: Gemini Enterprise and Google's new agent memory design
items.watch: Prices not yet published

items.best_for: Infrastructure and on-premises AI for firms that cannot send data out
